payload.summary: One self-review pass over the plan across completeness, consistency, feasibility and testability, checked against decision_index.py, the manifest validator, both prompt builders and their tests. Four feasibility gaps fixed in design and tasks.
completed_work: Confirmed 503 committed findings documents exist for the emitter regression test (64 already invalid, so the subset approach is required)

decisions.title: Report the canonical change id and look up supersession under both ids
decisions.rationale: extract_decisions takes the change id from the session-log parent dir, which is <date>-<id> for archived changes; a supersedes ref may use either form.

decisions.title: Match archive dirs exactly by date prefix
decisions.rationale: A glob of *-<id> would also match a longer change id ending in the same words.

decisions.title: Add evidence_level to vendor_review._FALLBACK_ENUMS
decisions.rationale: test_fallback_matches_the_schema requires every schema enum in the offline fallback; without it the schema edit breaks an existing test.

decisions.title: Name the sibling path textually and suppress bytecode
decisions.rationale: The manifest validator detects only the <skill-base-dir>/../<skill> form; importing decision_index could otherwise write __pycache__ into a sibling skill dir.
